mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, concat_ws('',A.PORTFOLIO_ID , ':' , A.PORTFOLIO_NAME) text, B.IS_GUARANTEE object FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '02'
and (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search}, '%') OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search}, '%') )
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
mapper.delete: delete from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STR_TO_DATE(#{valdate},'%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') >= VAL_DATE
mapper.update: update CREDIT_LINES x set HAP_CREDIT_AMT = (select case when (x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT - a.TRADE_AMT) > 0 then IFNULL(x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT, 0) - IFNULL(a.TRADE_AMT, 0) else 0 end atm from (select SEQNO, sum(TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, max(VAL_DATE) from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno) where exists (select 1 from (select SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno)
